# S9.4 — Coaching Session Summary

## User Story

**As** a ScaleUp user,
**I want** a session summary auto-generated when I run `/scaleup-close`,
**So that** I have a record of what was discussed, decided, and what's next.

## Size: S

## Acceptance Criteria

- Summary is auto-generated when `/scaleup-close` runs
- Includes: session duration, decisions worked on, worksheets completed, tasks created/completed, score changes
- Appended to `.scaleup/my-company/sessions/YYYY-MM-DD.md`
- Core Python module in `coaching/summary/`
- Integrated into existing `scaleup-close` orchestrator
- No user action required — runs automatically on close
